independent_axis_note: Evidence maturity is NOT the same thing as provenance class. A DERIVED object may have high maturity; an open photograph may still be E0 for metric geometry.

levels.name: REFERENCE_ONLY
levels.meaning: Visual, textual, or claim context; no metric model mutation allowed.

levels.name: CALIBRATED_SINGLE_VIEW
levels.meaning: Single image with one or more known scale anchors. Local 2-D estimates only; perspective uncertainty explicit.

levels.name: MULTIVIEW_RECONSTRUCTION
levels.meaning: Multi-image camera solution with scale anchor(s), QA metrics, and bounded reprojection error.

levels.name: SURVEY_CONSTRAINED
levels.meaning: Geometry constrained by published/direct survey measurements or authoritative plan dimensions.

levels.name: MAPPED_ELEMENT
levels.meaning: Specific slab/stone/object boundary mapped with direct metric evidence or convergent survey + image geometry.

levels.name: INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED
levels.meaning: Mapped element independently reproduced or cross-validated by a second measurement modality/team.
